svg.title: AI SDLC Orchestrator: Live gh-admin-msft to portfolio Pipeline
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough of the live johnhain-msft/mfg_msft_ai_sdlc pipeline keeping johnhain-msft/gh-admin-msft current and cascading into johnhain-msft/portfolio. 1 · Declarative Fleet Manifest & One-Command Bootstrap: sdlc.yaml registers gh-admin-msft (7 GHEC watched URLs) and sdlc-bootstrap.mjs provisions App #5671833 + state variables. 2 · Remote-Only 3-Agent Harness & Merge Bridge in gh-admin-msft: Stored under .github/sdlc/ so local Copilot CLI/VS Code sessions ignore it, while remote gh-aw runs execute all 3 phases. 3 · Upstream Drift Dry-Run Gate (Run #42525239087): dry_run=true snapshots all 7 GHEC URLs, runs Copilot CLI + 7 post-steps gates, and skips safe_outputs with zero remote writes. 4 · Live Upstream Drift Run & In-Sandbox Validation (#42531290378): Pre-agent npm ci enables in-sandbox execution of all 99 unit tests, 60 freshness checks (0 warnings), and 11 validation suites. 5 · Upstream Drift Pull Request #19 Opened & Merged on gh-admin-msft: mfg-msft-ai-sdlc[bot] opens PR #19 with source citations and full in-sandbox validation telemetry; CI passes and human merges. 6 · Central Event Router & Conditional ETag Poll (#42532934615): route-upstream.mjs detects gh-admin-msft advanced from a2f9a3bb to 49569501 (PR #19) and dispatches cascade-mechanical-ghec-admin. 7 · Downstream Mechanical Cascade & 7-Leg Portfolio Gate (#42532946999): Imports gh-admin-msft@495695012d56 into portfolio, passes build/catalog/typecheck/lint/test/studio/browser, and updates poll state. 8 · Downstream Cascade PR #1 on portfolio & Durable Sync State: mfg-msft-ai-sdlc[bot] opens PR #1 on johnhain-msft/portfolio with provenance pinned to 495695012d56 and poll state finalized.

g.text: sdlc.yaml registers gh-admin-msft (7 GHEC watched URLs) and sdlc-bootstrap.mjs provisions App #5671833 + state variables.

text.tspan: 2 · Remote-Only 3-Agent Harness & Merge Bridge in gh-admin-msft

g.text: Stored under .github/sdlc/ so local Copilot CLI/VS Code sessions ignore it, while remote gh-aw runs execute all 3 phases.
dry_run=true snapshots all 7 GHEC URLs, runs Copilot CLI + 7 post-steps gates, and skips safe_outputs with zero remote writes.

text.tspan: 4 · Live Upstream Drift Run & In-Sandbox Validation (#42531290378)

g.text: Pre-agent npm ci enables in-sandbox execution of all 99 unit tests, 60 freshness checks (0 warnings), and 11 validation suites.

text.tspan: 5 · Upstream Drift Pull Request #19 Opened & Merged on gh-admin-msft

g.text: mfg-msft-ai-sdlc[bot] opens PR #19 with source citations and full in-sandbox validation telemetry; CI passes and human merges.

text.tspan: 6 · Central Event Router & Conditional ETag Poll (#42532934615)

g.text: route-upstream.mjs detects gh-admin-msft advanced from a2f9a3bb to 49569501 (PR #19) and dispatches cascade-mechanical-ghec-admin.
Imports gh-admin-msft@495695012d56 into portfolio, passes build/catalog/typecheck/lint/test/studio/browser, and updates poll state.

text.tspan: 8 · Downstream Cascade PR #1 on portfolio & Durable Sync State

g.text: mfg-msft-ai-sdlc[bot] opens PR #1 on johnhain-msft/portfolio with provenance pinned to 495695012d56 and poll state finalized.
